architecture: C (conv, code 128), trained on cleaned plans
preprocessing: greyscale, invert (walls bright, background dark), pad to a square with black, resize to 128x128 (Lanczos), pixels scaled to 0-1; then cleaned: keep only lines thinner than 5 px (plan minus its 5x5 opening), scale by the 90th percentile of its lines, threshold 0.35
similarity: Euclidean distance between codes; smaller = more similar
